rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０１０Huh?￥So this is where you were.＝＠１８２＿０１１Tomoe was looking for you￥earlier. She seemed kind of￥desperate.
＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０１２That shy girl... she's really￥gotten attached to you.
＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０１３She's seemed different￥lately, right? Like she's￥gotten stronger?
＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０１４Oh!｝￥＠１８２＿０１５Speak of the devil,￥it's Tomoe.＝＠１８２＿０１６Hey! Tomoe!￥Over here!
＊Tomoe＊＠１８２＿０１７Hello.￥Oh, I'm so glad￥I ran into you here.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８２＿０１８Oh... is now a good time?￥Weren't you two in the middle￥of talking...?
＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０１９Of course.￥Besides, we were just￥talking about you, Tomoe.
＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０２１You've changed lately,￥haven't you, Tomoe? We were￥saying it suits you.
＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０２４About how you've gotten￥stronger. I think it's a really￥good look.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８２＿０２６Being seen that way...￥it makes me happy.
＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０２７Tomoe, you wanted to talk￥to him, right?＝＠１８２＿０２９Well then,￥I'll get out of your way.￥See you, you two~
＊Yoh＊＠１８２＿０２８Tomoe, you wanted to talk￥to her, right?＝＠１８２＿０２９Well then,￥I'll get out of your way.￥See you, you two~
＊Tomoe＊＠１８２＿０３１Um, could you spare me￥a little time?＝＠１８２＿０３２There's something I want￥to talk to you about.
－　Common Floor　－＝－　； and Tomoe are alone　－
＊Tomoe＊...＝＠１８３＿００１We've been here on Alpha￥for quite a while now.

＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿００２My reason for taking this exam￥was really simple at first.＝＠１８３＿００３I admired Elan, but going there￥never felt very real to me...＝＠１８３＿００４I think I joined more to find￥out what I was capable of.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿００５What about you...?＝＠１８３＿００６What brought you￥all this way?
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０３１What a wonderful dream.＝＠１８３＿００７We're... closer to that dream￥right now than ever, aren't we?
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿００９As long as you weren't pushed￥into this by the people around￥you...＝＠１８３＿０１０Carrying everyone's hopes on￥your own is hard, after all...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０１１My reasons were different, but￥my dream now is...＝＠１８３＿０１２to go to Elan, after all.＝＠１８３＿０１３Being here, I've really felt how￥much the planet Elan means...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０１４And through that, I came to￥truly want to go, not for anyone￥else, but for myself.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０１５I think coming to Alpha has￥changed me.＝＠１８３＿０１６I've learned to find courage,￥and to look at things more￥positively.＝＠１８３＿０１７And also...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０２１That it's important to face￥things head-on.＝＠１８３＿０２２That if I'm scared and just shut￥myself away, nothing will ever￥begin.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０２３I was able to realize that.＝＠１８３＿０２４And it's all thanks to you.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０２５If I hadn't met someone￥like you...＝＠１８３＿０２６I don't think I could have￥made it this far.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０２８It might not seem like much￥to you...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８３＿０３０Because you were there￥by my side...￥I was able to grow stronger.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８４＿００１I have a favor￥to ask you.￥...Will you hear me out?
＊Tomoe＊＠１８４＿００２I'd like you to hold on￥to this pendant for me.

＊Tomoe＊＠１８４＿００３All this time, I've￥relied completely on this￥pendant, but...＝＠１８４＿００４I don't think I need a place￥to run to anymore.＝＠１８４＿００５So I'd like you to keep it...￥you, who gave me the chance￥to change...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８４＿００６Yes...￥It holds so many memories.￥But...＝＠１８４＿００７That's exactly why I want￥you to keep it...＝＠１８４＿００８So I can let go of this￥pendant I've been hiding behind￥for so long...

＊Tomoe＊＠１８４＿０１０Until this exam is over,￥I'll give it everything I have.＝＠１８４＿０１１And someday, looking at￥that pendant...＝＠１８４＿０１２I want to be able to talk about￥the weak person I used to be￥as a fond memory...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８４＿０１３So... if it's possible...＝＠１８４＿０１４I hope that I can go to￥Elan together with you.
